Name: Bigger On The Inside
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
Your favorite building texture hasn't gotten an update in years... but you want to build the SVE buildings without destroying your farm's perfect vibes? We've all been there. 

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
Bigger On The Inside let's you keep using your favorite older farm building retextures but enjoy the premium SVE building interiors. It rewires the building fields to swap in textures from previous makes of the buildings!  This will work with nearly any building texture, modern or old, even vanilla.

[b]By default: [/b]
[list]
[*]Premium Barn will use texture from Deluxe Barn[/*]
[*]Premium Coop will use texture from Deluxe Coop[/*]
[*]SVE's Winery will use texture from Big Shed[/*]
[/list]In the configuration, you can switch that to use the minimum textures for Barn, Coop, and Shed instead. And I added an option for Big Shed to use Shed texture just as a courtesy incase the texture pack is old enough to not [i]have[/i] a Big Shed (which I ran into while testing.)

As an added bonus to the way this was designed, by default this mod can [b]upgrade your existing upgraded barn, coop, and shed buildings into SVE buildings[/b] since they will maintain the original footprint, but you can turn this off if you'd prefer to build them independantly.

This mod comes with a DLL whose sole purpose is to unpatch the SVE right-side door.
The interior barn door is blocked using a simple CP patch.

[b]Tested successfully with:[/b]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7160]Spanish Revival Buildings (WIP)[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6330]Elle's Seasonal Vanilla Buildings[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5825]Hisame's Pick of Buildings Mix[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3947]Seasonal Japanese Buildings[/url] (plus the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704]1.6 update[/url])[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2110]Hudson Valley Buildings - Complete Pack[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4544]Enchanted Garden Buildings[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12186]IdaIda's Seasonal Gothic Buildings[/url][/*]
[*]CocomiT's Time is Quiet and Peaceful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35897]Barn[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34967]Coop[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35904]Big Shed[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37726]Jeelh's Farm Buildings[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33312]Farm Buildings Revamped[/url][/*]
[*]... should work with ALL CP based building textures [/*]
[/list]Also tested with vanilla textures (check out the header!)
Additional compatibility added for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43227]Warm Stalls & Cozy Boxes[/url].

[b][size=3]✧ Considerations ✧ [/size][/b]
Since this mod adjusts the size and shape of buildings, if you disable it you may find your premium buildings overlap with things. It is recommended that in that situation you move them into a more normal placement by visiting Robin (or the Wizard). 

Configuration options in the [b]Return to title screen to see the changes [/b]section may make things look glitched out until you return to title. You may prefer to make these changes from the title screen by accessing GMCM from the ⚙️ button there.

Patches all use default door locations.  If a retexture moves animal or human doors, that might get tricky and require custom patches. I didn't encounter this in testing, but mods can do some neat tricks so if you run into this and need assistance please leave a comment.
